queueInterrupted: Previous run was interrupted. Resume queued requests explicitly.
modeAskHint: Ask: plain chat, the model gets no tools
modePlanHint: Plan: the model only reads the project and ends with a plan for you to approve
modeAgentHint: Agent: the model can read, edit and run commands
planApproveNote: Approving switches this chat to Agent mode.
allowlistDesc: One prefix per line. In “Ask for commands” mode these run without confirmation.
approveComputer: Perform these actions on your computer?
contextUsage: Context: about {tokens} tokens, {percent}% of the window
riskEnterAfterTyping: Pressing Return after typing may send a message or submit a form.
riskNewline: The typed text contains a line break, which may send or submit it.
riskDestructiveShortcut: This shortcut may quit an app, close a window or delete something.
agentsEmpty: No background agents yet. Subagents started by the agent show up here while they work.
agentsCommandNote: Started in the background by {provider}. It ends together with the run; Stop ends the whole run.
agentsContinuePlaceholder: What should the agent do next?
agentsContinueHint: Puts a request into the message box asking the main agent to continue this run with your follow-up. Review it, then send.
agentsStopCli: Stops the whole {provider} run, not just this agent.
agentsCliReadOnly: Started by {provider} itself. Gustaf only shows it: no transcript, no continue.
agentSettingsLead: Background subagents started by the main agent (spawn_agent, delegate_tasks): the model of each type, their limits, and when you are notified.
agentModelForTypeDesc: Model per agent type. Only API providers whose model supports tools can run subagents; otherwise the chat's model is used.
agentAllowedModelsDesc: The main agent may name one of these (or a type's model) in spawn_agent or delegate_tasks. Any other model is refused.
agentCheapModel: Model for summaries and commit messages
agentCheapModelDesc: Used to compact chats and to write commit messages. The chat's model is used when this one is unavailable.
agentBudgetsDesc: Empty fields use the default shown in grey. A run that reaches a limit stops and reports it. Subagent tokens also count toward the budgets above.
agentBudgetInvalid: Enter a positive number (whole for steps and tool calls), or leave the field empty for the default.
agentCancelDependents: Cancel dependent tasks when one fails
agentCancelDependentsDesc: For delegate_tasks plans. The main agent can change it for a single plan.
agentNotificationsDesc: A system notification and a badge on the app icon when a background agent finishes, fails or waits for approval while Gustaf is in the background.
codexSessions: Read Codex session files to show subagents
codexSessionsDesc: While a Codex chat runs, Gustaf reads only the session files of that run in your Codex folder to list its subagents live; nothing is sent anywhere.
agentStopOnBudgetDesc: When the daily or chat token budget (Usage, Budgets) is exceeded, running agents stop at their next step and new ones are not started. Budgets stay warnings everywhere else.
notifyApprovalBody: {who} is waiting for your approval in Gustaf.
archiveLead: Archived chats are hidden from the sidebar. Restore them any time.
askProject: Ask the agent to change the project, @ to mention a file
computerEnableDesc: Can also be toggled per message from the composer.
computerLead: Let the model see your screen and control the mouse and keyboard. Works with OpenAI and Anthropic models.
computerSafetyDesc: Each step is confirmed unless access is Full. Typing and Enter/{mod} shortcuts always need confirmation. Limit: 30 steps or 10 minutes. {stop} stops the agent.
cliSubscription: CLI on this computer, uses your subscription
cliCommandHint: Runs in the project folder through a login shell
cliFound: Found on this computer: connects without a key, uses your subscription
cursorHint: Uses the Cursor SDK agent with your project folder. Requires Node.js 22+ installed.
cursorNothing: No Cursor chats found on this computer.
detectLocalHint: Find Ollama or LM Studio running on this computer.
gitLead: Checkpoints are stored in a separate hidden repository and never touch your project’s git.
cmdRulesLead: Choose which shell commands the agent may run. Allow runs without asking, Ask always asks, Deny blocks the command in every access mode, and Deny always wins. Each command in a line (after && ; | or inside $(…)) is judged on its own, and a pattern describes a single command.
cmdPatternPlaceholder: e.g. git push or npm run *
cmdPatternHint: “Starts with” matches the first words of a command (git status also matches git status -s). “Glob” matches the whole command: * is any text, ? is one character.
cmdErrCompound: A rule describes one command: remove ; & | < >, backticks and $(…), or add separate rules.
cmdErrUnsupported: This pattern cannot be used. Check the quotes and drop VAR=value prefixes and redirections.
cmdErrTooMany: Too many rules. Delete some first.
cmdNoRules: No rules yet. The built-in protections below are on unless you turn them off.
cmdBuiltinLead: These commands are blocked in every access mode and no allow rule can override them. Turn one off only if you really need that command.
cmdBuiltinRmRoot: Recursive delete of /, your home folder or system folders
cmdBuiltinChmodRoot: Recursive chmod or chown of / or your home folder
cmdBuiltinCurlSh: Downloaded script piped into a shell or interpreter
cmdBuiltinDisk: Formatting or overwriting disks (mkfs, dd of=/dev/…)
cmdTryLead: See what the rules would do with a command, without running it.
cmdTryPlaceholder: Paste a command, e.g. git status && rm -rf build
cmdVerdictDefault: No rule matches: it asks in “Ask for commands” mode and runs in “Full access” mode.
cmdVerdictReadonly: Blocked: read-only mode does not run commands.
cmdVerdictParse: The command could not be fully understood, so no allow rule applies to it.
actionLogLead: Every tool call the agent made, newest first: commands with how they were allowed, and file edits. Undo restores a file edit made in a review copy while the change is still pending in Changes. Commands cannot be undone.
logFullAccess: Ran in full access: no rule matched
scheduledLead: Run a prompt on a schedule in its own chat, unattended. Prompts only run while Gustaf is open and the computer is awake. A run that was missed while the app was closed happens once on the next start if it was due within the last 24 hours, otherwise it is skipped. Whether to keep the computer awake is up to you; Gustaf does not change system settings.
scheduledSafety: Unattended runs never get full access or Computer Use and cannot start subagents; CLI agents are read-only. A command that needs approval is never allowed automatically: it waits for you (sidebar badge, notification and a card in the corner) and the run stops as "needs attention" after 10 minutes. A new or edited schedule starts only after you switch it on.
scheduledNone: No schedules yet. Create one to run a prompt on a timetable.
scheduledNotConfirmed: Off. Switch it on to start; changes to the prompt or time switch it off again.
scheduledAccessAuto: Auto (edits go to a review copy)
scheduledSavedOff: Saved. It is off until you switch it on.
scheduledIssuePromptLong: The prompt is too long (at most {max} characters).
scheduledIssueInterval: The interval must be a whole number of at least {min} minutes.
scheduledIssueOnce: Pick a time in the future.
scheduledNoProvider: The provider of this schedule is not available. Edit the schedule and pick another model.
scheduledNoteAttention: Scheduled run stopped: a command waited too long for your approval.
scheduledChatRunning: Scheduled run "{title}" is writing to this chat…
scheduledChatBusy: The scheduled run "{title}" is writing to this chat. Wait for it to finish or press Stop.
scheduledNotifyAttention: Needs attention: a command is waiting for approval.
scheduledApprovalTitle: {title}: scheduled run asks to run a command
scheduledApprovalHint: The run stops if nobody answers for 10 minutes.
logUndoTitle: Restore the file as it was before this edit
undoBusy: The agent is still working in this copy.
undoLater: A later edit of this file has to be undone first.
undoChanged: The file changed after this edit, so it was left alone.
undoClosed: This change was already accepted or rejected in Changes.
undoUnsupported: This file cannot be restored safely (binary, too large or not text).
undoNone: Nothing to undo for this entry.
importFromAppSub: We found settings you can bring into Gustaf
historyImport: Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT history
historyImportSub: Only the conversations are imported, never settings, keys or env files. Folders named in a session are not added as projects.
historyPickFileSub: In ChatGPT: Settings, Data controls, Export data. Unzip the archive and choose conversations.json.
historyMore: {count} more, narrow the search to see them
importLead: Bring projects and chats from other AI apps.
chatFilesSub: Export chats to Markdown or JSON, or restore chats from a JSON export. API keys are never included.
shareHtmlIntro: One self-contained file: it opens in any browser, loads nothing from the network and runs no scripts.
shareHtmlRedactions: {count} secrets were redacted. Review the page before sharing it.
shareHtmlRedactions_one: {count} secret was redacted. Review the page before sharing it.
shareHtmlRedactions_other: {count} secrets were redacted. Review the page before sharing it.
shareHtmlNoRedactions: No secrets were found. Review the page before sharing it: file paths and project names stay in.
importChatsFile: Import chats from a JSON file
importChatsFileSub: Chats that already exist are skipped.
importErr_invalid_json: This file is not valid JSON.
importErr_not_export: This file is not an Gustaf chat export.
importErr_unsupported_version: This export was made by a newer version of Gustaf.
importErr_empty: The file contains no chats to import.
importErr_too_large: The file is too large to import (limit {mb} MB).
keyUnchanged: Leave empty to keep the current key
mcpLead: Tools from these servers are offered to agents of API providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, local models). Every call asks first unless you allow it below.
mcpImportHint: Paste an mcpServers JSON block (Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code format). Values that look like secrets are stored in {store}.
mcpSecretHint: Stored in {store}, never in the settings database
mcpSecretKept: Stored in the system key store; leave empty to keep
mcpAlwaysAllowServer: Always allow every tool of this server
mcpReadOnlyHint: Only tools you mark read-only are offered in read-only mode. Hints from the server are shown but not trusted.
mcpCliNote: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent read their own MCP configuration; these servers are not passed to them.
mcpErr_invalid: Unrecognized format: expected an mcpServers object.
mcpErr_nameTaken: Another server already has this name.
mcpErr_value: Invalid value (too long or contains line breaks).
mcpErr_url: URL must be https:// (or http:// to localhost).
mcpErr_cwd: Working directory must be an absolute path.
mcpErr_sse: The legacy SSE transport is not supported; use the server's streamable HTTP URL.
mcpErr_oauth: Invalid OAuth settings (client ID or scope too long).
mcpOauthHint: The server asks for authorization in your browser. Tokens are stored in {store}. Most servers register Gustaf automatically; enter a client ID only if yours does not.
mcpOauthPhase_browser: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…
mcpResourceListDesc: Built-in: lets the agent list this server's resources
mcpResourceReadDesc: Built-in: lets the agent read one resource by URI
name: Name
noChanges: No changes in this chat yet.
noCommands: The agent hasn’t run any commands.
noFavorites: Star models to see them here.
onbImportLead: Import chats from Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or ChatGPT. You can import more later in Settings.
onbProviderLead: Connect at least one model. Keys are stored in {store}.
onboardingDesc: Import projects and connect providers again.
computerUnsupportedHere: Nothing to grant on this system
permAccessibilityDesc: Needed to move the mouse and type.
providersLead: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Cursor, local models or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
editResendHint: Messages from this one on are replaced, and project files go back to how they were before it (when a checkpoint exists).
deleteExchange: Delete this message and its reply
rulesLead: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules and .cursor/rules with alwaysApply are added to the agent’s instructions (CLIs that read some of them themselves are not given a second copy).
instructionsCustomHint: Added to the agent’s system prompt for this project (up to {max} characters). They cannot loosen the command rules or approvals.
instructionsPlaceholder: For example: use pnpm, not npm. Tests live in tests/. Reply in Russian.
instructionsFound: Instruction files found in the project
instructionsNoFiles: None of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules or always-apply .cursor/rules found.
instructionsUntrusted: Instruction files are untrusted project content: they cannot grant permissions or override the command rules.
searchHint: Search the text of every message in all chats. Put words in quotes for an exact phrase.
searchRecentFirst: Very common words: newest first. Add words to rank by relevance.
searchShowingCapped: {count} of {total}+, add words to narrow them
shortcutsLead: Click Change and press the new keys. Text-editing keys in the message box are never overridden.
liveMeterHint: Estimate from text length while the reply is running. Exact provider usage appears when the step finishes.
compareReadOnly: Read-only: no tools, no file changes. Answers are not saved unless you continue one in a chat.
comparePrompt: Prompt to send to every selected model
compareNoModels: No models available. Add a provider in Settings.
compareNoProvider: The provider of this model is no longer configured.
compareRetryable: This looks temporary; running it again may help.
compareNotRetryable: Running it again will not help until the cause is fixed.
compareContinue: Continue in chat with this answer
compareUsageHint: Token counts reported by the provider.
usageLead: Requests sent from this computer, per provider.
canvasCopyError: Could not copy code. Select it in the Code tab.
canvasRepairPrompt:
Fix canvas "{id}". Return a complete corrected tsx-canvas block with the same id. Error:
{error}
providerCheckHint: Sends a short test request using your selected model.
tokenUsageLead: Provider-reported tokens in Gustaf since tracking was enabled. Cached tokens are included in input; account limits are shared with other apps.
tokensUnavailable: No reported token counts yet. Some CLIs do not return them.
limitsUnavailable: No account quota data received. Check your provider dashboard.
agentsBudgetsLead: Token limits, background agent roles and models, and agent notifications. Statistics are on the Usage page.
usageEmpty: No token usage in this period.
usageLoadFailed: Could not read usage from the chat history.
usageMissingReplies: {count} replies had no token counts and are not included.
usageAgentsNote: Background agent tokens are shown for the last 31 days and are not split by provider.
budgetsLead: Optional token limits for one day or one chat. Warnings never block sending. Only token counts reported by providers are used, and no prices are estimated.
budgetDayLimitDesc: All chats, per local calendar day. Resets at local midnight.
budgetChatLimitDesc: Each chat separately. Every request counts, including history that is sent again.
budgetWarnAtDesc: Percent of a token limit or an account quota window at which a warning appears.
budgetLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number of tokens (for example 500000, 500k or 2m), or leave it empty for no limit.
budgetStatusPartial: {scope}: at least {used} of {limit} tokens ({percent}%). Some replies had no token counts
budgetStatusUnavailable: {scope}: unavailable. The provider did not report tokens for these replies
alertDayWarning: Daily token budget at {percent}%: {used} of {limit} tokens.
alertDayExceeded: Daily token budget exceeded: {used} of {limit} tokens. Sending is not blocked.
alertDayUnavailable: The daily token budget cannot be checked: today's replies have no token counts from the provider.
alertChatWarning: Chat token budget at {percent}%: {used} of {limit} tokens.
alertChatExceeded: Chat token budget exceeded: {used} of {limit} tokens. Sending is not blocked.
alertChatUnavailable: The chat token budget cannot be checked: replies in this chat have no token counts from the provider.
cursorAccountsHint: Each account signs in through the Cursor CLI into its own isolated profile; the computer’s shared login and your API keys are untouched.
cursorAccountStatusError: Could not read the account status
cursorLoginWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser. Waiting for the Cursor CLI…
cursorLoginFailed: Sign-in was not completed (timed out or the CLI exited). Nothing was saved.
cursorCliAccountHint: Separate Cursor CLI account using its API key. Does not change the computer’s shared Cursor login.
cursorSwitched: Switched Cursor account: {from} → {to}. A fresh session starts; the chat history carries the context.
cursorModelFallback: Model {from} is not available on this account, using {to}.
cursorAllExhausted: All Cursor accounts are out of quota. The earliest one resets {time}. You can mark an account as available in Settings, Providers.
cursorAllExhaustedUnknown: All Cursor accounts are out of quota. You can mark an account as available in Settings, Providers.
cursorActiveAccount: Cursor account for the next message: {name}
cursorPoolHint: Ordered accounts. The next message uses the first account with quota, starting from the active one and wrapping around. API-key accounts are used only when no other account has quota.
cursorPoolNeedTwo: Add at least one more account to rotate between accounts.
actionNoOutput: The provider did not return output for this action.
contextLastInput: Input tokens in last request (not history size)
contextEstimateHint: Estimate of conversation text. Excludes system instructions, tool schemas and images. Not billing usage.
compactHint: AI creates a summary; originals stay in the chat. Long histories are processed in chunks and may use multiple model requests.
compactFailed: The model did not return a text-only summary. The chat was not changed.
reviewHint: The model edits a copy of your files. Accept individual files or single hunks to copy them into the project. Dependencies and ignored files are excluded.
reviewSetupIntro: Optional, per project. The shadow copy leaves out node_modules and build output, so builds and tests may fail there.
reviewSetupLinks: Link these directories into the copy (one per line)
reviewSetupLinksWarn: Linked directories are symlinks to your real ones, meant for reading. Commands run in the copy can still write through them (for example npm install). Changes inside them are never applied or listed.
reviewSetupCommand: Setup command, run once in each new copy
reviewTestCommand: Test command, run on demand before accepting
reviewSetupApproval: Commands run only inside the copy and follow the command approval rules, including the always-allowed list.
reviewSetupDeclined: Setup command was not run: you declined it. The copy may lack dependencies.
reviewSetupFailed:
Setup command failed ({code}). The copy may lack dependencies.
{output}
reviewRunApprove: Run this command in the copy?
reviewRunBlocked: Blocked by your command rules or read-only mode.
reviewTestsStale: Result is from before the latest changes
aiReviewHint: Read-only: the model only reads the diff and lists findings. Nothing is changed.
aiReviewUnparsable: The model did not return findings in the expected format. Try again or pick another model.
feedbackWaiting: The agent is working. Send the comments when it finishes.
feedbackHint: The comments are put into the message box as one follow-up; you can edit them before sending.
feedbackSent: Comments were put into the message box. Press send to deliver them to the agent.
restoreContextHint: Remove only the summaries and send the entire conversation again.
imagesUnsupported: The selected model does not accept images. Select another model or remove the images.
gitPublishNote: Nothing is pushed unless you click Push.
gitNoUpstream: not on the remote yet (push will set the upstream)
gitPushDetached: HEAD is detached: create a branch before pushing.
gitPushNoRemote: This repository has no usable remote (or several and none is called origin). Add one with git remote add.
gitPushNoCommits: There are no commits to push yet.
gitProtectedWarn: {branch} is a protected branch. Pushing straight to it skips review. Create a new branch for this commit first, or confirm the push.
gitProtectedNote: The new branch starts at this commit; {branch} stays where it is locally and nothing is pushed until you click Push.
gitBranchSwitched: Switched to {branch}. Push it when you are ready.
gitPrGhMissing: GitHub CLI (gh) is not installed. Install it from cli.github.com and run gh auth login.
gitPrGhSignedOut: GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run gh auth login in a terminal.
gitPrNoBase: No base branch found on the remote.
gitPrSameBase: The base branch must differ from the current branch.
gitPrTitleLong: The title must be one line of up to 256 characters.
gitPrBodyPlaceholder: Describe the change, or generate a draft from the diff.
gitPrNote: Uses gh pr create; you can edit everything above.
gitPrBadUrl: The link is not a safe https URL.
gitNotRepo: This project is not a git repository.
gitDetachedHint: HEAD is detached. Create a branch so the commit does not get lost.
gitInProgress: A {state} is in progress. Finish it before committing.
gitDirty: {count} changed files in the working tree
gitDirty_one: {count} changed file in the working tree
gitDirty_other: {count} changed files in the working tree
gitFilesOther: Other changes in the working tree
gitFilesNote: Only the files you tick are committed.
gitMessagePlaceholder: Subject line, then an optional description
gitModelNote: Generated with {model}. Review it before committing.
gitNoModel: Select a model in the composer to generate a message.
gitMessageFailed: The model returned no usable commit message. Write one manually.
gitBranchAuto: Leave empty to use the suggested name.
gitSafetyNote: Git hooks run as usual. Nothing is pushed automatically.
memoryLead: Saved facts shared across chats. Project facts apply only to that project. Selected facts are sent to the chosen model; never save secrets.
memoryApproval: Ask before the model changes memory
diagnosticsLead: Choose a project check. Automatic checks run after API-agent edits in the review workspace and obey command approvals. Native CLIs receive the check instruction.
diagnosticsNoCommand: No suitable check found. Enter your command.
imageUnsupported: The model does not support images
scheduledSummary: Runs while Gustaf is open and the computer is awake; commands that need approval wait for you.
hooksLead: Commands that run on agent events (before and after a tool call, after an edit, when the agent stops, when an approval is asked). They apply to API-provider agents only; CLI providers keep their own hooks. Hook commands follow the same command rules and approvals as the agent's own commands.
hooksWarning: Hooks run shell commands on your computer without you looking at each call. Enable project hooks only for projects you trust; a project file can contain any command.
hooksProjectOff: The project file exists but its hooks are off and will not run.
hooksNone: No hooks are in effect for this project.
workspaceNewHint: A separate git worktree and branch for this task. Your main checkout stays untouched.
workspaceRunInHint: Run the next message in its own git worktree and branch. Your main checkout stays untouched.
workspaceFallback: A workspace needs a git repository with at least one commit ({reason}). Running in the project folder instead.
workspaceSetupDeclined: The setup command was not run. Dependencies may be missing in the workspace.
workspaceSetupAskBody: The project's setup command will run inside the new workspace:
workspaceArchiveDirtyBody: {branch} has uncommitted changes. Archiving removes its folder and discards them. The branch and the chat are kept.
workspaceMissing: This workspace was archived or removed, so nothing can run in it. Start a new workspace to continue.
workspaceDiffHint: Everything changed on {branch} since it was created, including uncommitted edits.
workspaceDiffEmpty: No changes against the base yet.
reviewCopySettingDesc: Off (default): the agent edits your project folder directly; use the checkpoint (Revert file / Revert all) or git to undo. On: each run works in a private copy and you accept files or hunks into the project. Subagents and scheduled runs always use their own copy.
reviewCopyDirectNote: Review copy is off: edits are applied directly to the project folder. Undo with Revert file / Revert all or git.
branchChooseModel: Choose provider and model before branching
branchTransferDetails: Only history through the selected turn is copied, including attachments and recorded tool results. Creating a branch never executes tools. The next run starts a fresh provider session from copied context; native session state and provider-private context do not transfer. Switching models may change capabilities. Branch histories are independent; workspace files remain shared.
changesLinesUnknown: Line counts are not available for new, untracked files.
mobileLead: A local server that lets the Gustaf companion app on your phone read your projects and chats over your home or office network. Read-only: the phone cannot send messages or approve anything. Off by default.
mobileWarning: Turning this on opens a port on your local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet). Anyone on that network can reach it, but only phones you pair with a one-time code can read your projects and chats. Do not turn it on on public or shared networks. Traffic is encrypted and the phone pins this computer's certificate.
mobilePortHint: Leave empty to pick a free port once and remember it. Changeable while the server is off.
mobilePairSub: Open Gustaf on the phone, choose Pair and scan this code. The code works once and expires after 2 minutes.
mobileCodeExpired: The code expired. Show a new one to pair.
mobileScanHint: The phone must be on the same network.
agentRolesLead: Let a delegated task name a role, or a provider such as Codex, Claude Code or Cursor Agent, instead of a model.
agentRolesDesc: A role is a preset: the provider and model a task runs on when it names the role. Its provider must also be allowed below; choosing one here allows it.
agentRoleModel: Provider and model for the {role} role
agentAllowedProvidersDesc: Providers that spawn_agent and delegate_tasks may name. A CLI agent works in its own git worktree on a gustaf/ branch that is left for you to merge; it never merges or pushes.
agentCleanupWorktreesDesc: When a CLI subagent ends without changing anything, remove its worktree and branch. Off: they are always kept.
memoryProjectHint: Project facts apply only here; global facts apply to every chat.
memorySuggestAuto: Suggest memories at the end of chats
memorySuggestAutoHint: Off by default. When on, after a chat has had a few exchanges Gustaf sends one more request with the chat text (secrets redacted, tool outputs left out) to your cheap model or the chat model, and shows what it proposes. Nothing is saved without your confirmation. You can always run it by hand from a chat's menu.
memoryExportIntro: Writes this project's saved facts into a section of AGENTS.md between gustaf-memory markers, so other tools that read AGENTS.md can see them. Only that section is created or replaced; the rest of the file is left as it is. Review the resulting file below, then confirm.
memoryExportGlobalSub: Global facts are personal preferences; the file may be committed and shared with your team.
memoryExportAction_append: The section will be added at the end of AGENTS.md
memoryExportAction_update: The existing Gustaf section will be updated
memoryExportAction_unchanged: AGENTS.md is already up to date
memoryExportNothing: There are no facts to export.
memoryExportChanged: The file or the facts changed since the preview. Review the updated text and confirm again.
memoryExportMalformed: AGENTS.md has unbalanced or duplicated gustaf-memory markers, so nothing was changed. Fix or remove the markers by hand and try again.
memoryExportUnreadable: AGENTS.md exists but could not be read back completely (too large, not UTF-8 text or not a regular file), so nothing was changed.
memorySuggestCost: This makes one more model request that sends the text of this chat (secrets redacted, tool outputs left out) to your model provider. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
memorySuggestNone: No new durable facts found in this chat.
memorySuggestUnparsable: The model's answer could not be read as a list of facts. Try again.
verifLead: Required checks that run when an agent finishes a task in which it edited files (API-provider agents only; CLI providers have their own loops). If a check fails, its output goes back to the agent to fix. Commands follow your command rules and approvals.
verifNone: No checks: runs finish without verification.
verifSuggestNone: No typecheck, lint or test scripts were found to suggest.
verifSuggestNote: Suggestions are only filled in here; nothing runs until you save and an agent finishes a task.
verifFixAttempts: Fix attempts after a failed check
verifFileEnable: Also run the checks from this project's {file}
verifFileWarning: These checks run shell commands on your computer after agent runs, without you looking at each call. Enable the project file only for projects you trust; it can contain any command.
verifFileOff: The project file exists but is off; its checks will not run.
verifRetry: Check failed, sent back to the agent (fix attempt {n} of {max})
verifReasonMax: The checks still fail after the allowed fix attempts.
verifReasonRepeated: The same failure repeated three times in a row, so the run stopped early.
verifReasonBlocked: A check was blocked by your command rules.
verifReasonDeclined: A check was declined, so verification stopped.
verifTryModelHint: A different model may handle this failure better. Nothing is re-run automatically.
mqIntro: Merges the checked workspaces one after another into their base branch, in the order shown. Nothing is pushed. You can close this window: the queue keeps running and is saved.
mqNoWorkspaces: This project has no active workspaces.
mqPick: Workspaces to merge, in merge order
mqStrategyHint_merge: keeps the branch history and adds a merge commit
mqStrategyHint_fast_forward: rebases the branch onto the target, then moves the target forward; no merge commit
mqStrategyHint_squash: rebases, then adds the whole branch as a single commit
mqTestHint: Runs inside each workspace before it is merged, under your command rules and approval. A failing test stops the queue.
mqResumeHint: Queues the failed workspace again (after the others) and continues
mqHalted: Stopped after a failure. Fix it, then press Resume; or skip the failed workspace, or cancel the queue.
mqPaused: The queue is paused. Press Continue to run the rest.
mqBadgeTitle: Merge conflicts of {title}: click for the files
mqPopoverMore: {count} conflicting files in total; the list is shortened.
mqPopoverHint: Found without changing any files. Resolve them before merging.
mqTestDeclined: The test command was not approved, so it was not run.
mqTestBlocked: The test command is blocked by your command rules or by read-only mode, so it was not run.
mqResolveNoTests: run the project's tests if it has any
mqErr_target_dirty: The main checkout has uncommitted changes, so nothing can be merged into it. Commit or stash them there, then press Try again. ({detail})
mqErr_target_not_checked_out: The main checkout is not on the branch this workspace merges into. Switch it to that branch, then press Try again. ({detail})
mqErr_dirty: A workspace has uncommitted changes. Commit them in that workspace first, then try again. ({detail})
mqErr_queue_busy: Another merge step is still running. Wait a moment, then press Try again.
mqErr_already_queued: One of these workspaces is already in the queue. Let the queue finish or cancel it first.
mqErr_not_found: A workspace folder is missing (archived or deleted). Uncheck that workspace and try again. ({detail})
mqErr_git_too_old: Merging needs git 2.38 or newer. Update git, then try again.
mqErr_invalid_strategy: This way of merging is not supported. Pick another one.
mqErr_not_a_git_repo: This project is not a git repository.
mqErr_no_commits: This repository has no commits yet.
autoReviewSettingDesc: After an agent run, a read-only AI review of the pending changes runs in the background. Its findings appear in the Changes panel like a manual review; nothing is changed. It uses the review model or the cheap model from Settings > Agents when set, else the chat's model. Binary, ignored and secret-looking files are never sent, secrets in the diff are redacted, and a diff above the size limit is skipped with a note.
autoReviewCost: Cost: each review is one more model request that sends the diff to the provider and counts in usage and budgets.
autoReviewTriggerAfterRun: After each agent run that produced changes
autoReviewProjectsHint: Override the default for one project.
autoReviewUnparsable: Automatic review: the model did not return findings in the expected format.
autoReviewSkippedLarge: Automatic review skipped: the changes are too large to send ({files} files; a review sends up to {limit} characters and {maxFiles} files). Use Review all with AI for a partial review.
autoReviewSkippedEmpty: Automatic review skipped: nothing to review (binary, ignored and secret-looking files are never sent).
autoReviewSkippedCli: Automatic review skipped: the review model is a CLI agent. Choose an API model for the review agent in Settings > Agents.
reviewRulesTruncated: Rules: {path} (only the first {kb} KB are used)
gateTitle: {count} high-severity findings — review or dismiss first
gateTitle_one: {count} high-severity finding — review or dismiss first
gateTitle_other: {count} high-severity findings — review or dismiss first
gateHint: This is a warning, not a block: you can still continue.
quickAskSwitchDesc: A small always-on-top window opened by a global shortcut: ask a question and get a streamed answer from your default model. Nothing is saved unless you open it in Gustaf. Off by default.
quickAskStatusOff: Turn the switch on to register the shortcut.
quickAskRecording: Press the new shortcut, Esc to cancel
quickAskHideOnBlur: Hide when the window loses focus
quickAskRecNeedsModifier: Use at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Cmd or Win together with the key.
quickAskRecUnsupported: That key cannot be used in a global shortcut.
quickAskRecReserved: The system uses that shortcut. Choose another one.
quickAskErrInvalid: That shortcut is not valid, so it was not registered.
quickAskErrModifier: A global shortcut needs at least one modifier key, so it was not registered.
quickAskErrTaken: The shortcut could not be registered. Another app probably uses it: choose a different one.
quickAskErrOther: The quick ask shortcut could not be registered.
quickAskClipboardPreview: Clipboard text sent with your question
quickAskClipboardChars: {n} characters of clipboard text will be sent.
quickAskClipboardCut: Only the first {n} characters are sent.
quickAskClipboardEmpty: The clipboard has no text; nothing extra is sent.
quickAskClipboardDenied: The clipboard could not be read.
quickAskNotSaved: Not saved unless you open it in Gustaf.
quickAskBudget: The daily token budget is used up. Raise it in Settings, Usage, to ask more.
quickAskNoModel: No model available. Add an API provider in Settings; CLI providers do not work in the quick ask window.
quickAskFallback: Your default model runs through a CLI, which the quick ask window cannot use. Showing another model.
knowledgeLead: Named collections of your folders, PDFs, Markdown and text files. Chats can search them by meaning and cite the sources. Collections are stored in Gustaf's app data, never inside your folders.
knowledgePrivacy: Indexing sends the text of the files to the embeddings provider you choose; every search also sends the query there. A local Ollama keeps everything on this computer, a cloud endpoint receives the text and may bill the requests. Hidden and ignored files, secrets, binary files and scanned PDFs (no OCR) are not indexed. Only API chats use collections; Claude, Codex and Cursor CLI chats do not.
knowledgeNoSources: Add a folder or file to index.
knowledgeConfirmBody: This sends the text of {files} files ({size}) to {provider}.
knowledgeConfirmRemote: The text leaves this computer and the provider may bill the requests.
knowledgeConfirmLocal: The endpoint is on this computer; nothing leaves it.
mcpTransportHint: Automatic detection tries streamable HTTP first and switches to the legacy SSE transport when the server rejects the first request with a 4xx error (not 401, 403 or 429). Choose one to skip the detection.
mcpRevokeNote: Sign out asks the authorization server to revoke the tokens when it supports that (best effort), then deletes them from {store}.
mcpResourceTemplatesDesc: Built-in: lets the agent list this server's resource templates (read them with the read tool)
provAbout_claude: Claude Code CLI (uses your Claude subscription and the CLI's own sign-in) or an Anthropic API key.
provAbout_codex: Codex CLI (uses your ChatGPT subscription and the CLI's own sign-in) or an OpenAI API key.
provAbout_cursor: Cursor Agent CLI accounts (browser sign-in or API key, several accounts form a pool) or the Cursor SDK with an API key.
provAbout_grok: xAI Grok models through the OpenAI-compatible API at api.x.ai. Needs an xAI API key.
provCliMissing: Not found on PATH. Install it, sign in, then reopen this dialog.
provCliSignIn: The CLI uses its own sign-in: run {command} in a terminal if it asks.
provMethodCliKey: Cursor Agent CLI with an API key
provMethodSdk: Cursor SDK with an API key
provSignInCommand: Sign in with {command} in a terminal, then check again.
provNoBaseUrl: This provider has no base URL or paths to configure.
provBrowserDone: Accounts you sign in appear in the list on the left.
modelsRefreshFailed: Couldn't refresh this list. Showing the saved one.
rewindKeepFilesHint: Removes this message and everything after it; your files stay as they are
rewindWithFilesHint: Also puts the project files back to how they were before this message
pasteTooLarge: This paste is larger than the draft limit (200,000 characters).
mermaidInvalid: Can't draw this diagram; showing the code
chatWidthHint: How wide the conversation and the message box are on large screens
goalCommandHint: Keep working until a goal is met / Работать до достижения цели
snoozeInPast: Pick a time in the future.
fanOutHint: Shift-click to send one prompt to several models, each in its own workspace
fanOutPickedHint: {count} of up to {max} models: each gets its own workspace when you send
fanOutStarted: Started in {count} workspaces. They run in the background; see Working in the sidebar.
fanOutNoImages: Pictures can't be sent to several models yet. Remove them or pick one model.
scratchHint: A chat without a project, with its own folder for files
secretNote: Goes to one command as an environment variable. It is not saved in the chat, and it is masked in the output.
prWatchNeedsChat: Start watching from a chat that has a project and at least one message.
prWatchStopped_unreadable: stopped: GitHub could not be read for 15 minutes
prWatchCommandHint: Watch a pull request: /watch <url or number> / Следить за PR
webhooksLead: A signed POST to the URL runs the schedule now, with the payload attached as untrusted data. The server listens on this computer only (127.0.0.1); to receive GitHub webhooks, expose it with a tunnel you run, set the content type to application/json and paste the secret into the webhook's Secret field.
webhooksIdle: Off: no webhook is switched on
webhooksScheduleOff: The schedule is off: deliveries are recorded but do not run it.
sendNewChat: Send and open a new chat
followUpOpposite: While the agent works: the other follow-up action
followUpSettingDesc: What sending a message does while the agent is still working in this chat. Either way only one run goes at a time: queued messages start in order after the current one ends. Providers without steering always queue.
followUpHintQueue: Next request, runs after this one. {keys}: refine the current work instead
followUpHintSteer: Refines the current work. {keys}: queue as the next request instead
followUpHintRestart: Interrupts the current step and continues with your message. {keys}: queue as the next request instead
followUpHintQueueRestart: Next request, runs after this one. {keys}: interrupt the current step and continue with your message instead
followUpHintQueueOnly: Next request, runs after this one. This provider cannot take changes mid-run
restartSessionHint: Next message starts a fresh session (new skills, plugins, MCP)
sessionRestarted: The next message starts a fresh agent session; the conversation is sent as history.
cleanupDesc: Once a day, remove the folder of a workspace chat that has been idle for a while and has no uncommitted changes. The branch and the chat stay; open the chat to see it archived.
cleanupExplain: Two separate policies with their own periods; both are off by default and only touch Gustaf's own data folder. Deleted: the checkout folder of an idle workspace chat, and raw CLI log files of past days. Kept: branches and commits, chats and their history, workspaces with uncommitted changes, today's log and logs younger than the period. Stops working: links and file paths into a removed workspace folder, and links to a deleted log file.
cleanupLogsDesc: Once a day, delete the raw CLI log files (one file per day) that are older than the period. Today's log and the logs of the last days are never deleted.
cleanupNowDesc: Preview lists exactly what the current settings would delete. Nothing is removed until you press Clean up now.
cleanupNothing: Nothing to delete with the current settings.
cleanupKeptDirty: {n} idle workspaces have uncommitted changes and stay untouched.
codexAppServerDesc: Talk to Codex over its app-server protocol instead of codex exec: subagents report their real status, model and progress. Falls back to codex exec if the app-server cannot start. Turn off if a Codex run misbehaves.
importCursorSub: Pick Cursor projects to bring their chats.
interruptedHint: Worktrees with uncommitted changes or unmerged commits that no chat owns.
interruptedDiscardBody: This deletes the checkout and the branch {branch}, including {files} uncommitted files and: {commits}. It cannot be undone.
agentsInterruptedNote: Stopped before it finished. Check Interrupted agent work for changes it left behind.
stopAgentsBody: Stopping the run also stops its background agents. Their unfinished work stays in their worktrees.
gitBarTruncated: Only the most recent branches are listed. Type a name to narrow it down.
gitCreateHint: Uncommitted changes come along to the new branch.
gitLockedRunning: Wait for the run to finish before switching branches.
gitLockedReview: Accept or reject the pending review changes before switching branches.
gitLockedOp: A {op} is in progress. Finish it before switching branches.
gitLockedWorktree: This chat works in its own worktree; its branch is fixed.
gitDirtyBody: Switching now could mix them into another branch. Stash sets them aside (untracked files too) and puts them back after the switch; nothing is discarded.
gitSwitchedStashed: Switched to {branch}; your changes were stashed and restored.
gitSwitchedKept: Switched to {branch}. Your changes could not be applied on top of it and stay in the stash "{label}" (git stash pop).
gitErrElsewhere: That branch is checked out in another worktree: {path}
gitErrOp: Finish the running merge, rebase or cherry-pick first.
storageLead: Clean-up of old workspace checkouts to free disk space.
webLead: Search and page reading for API models.
webToolsDesc: Brave Search API and public HTTPS pages. Search queries are sent to Brave. Auto mode asks before each action. CLI providers use their own tools.
shortcutCtx_global: Everywhere, even when Gustaf is in the background
shortcutCtx_composer: In the message box and model picker
shortcutErrNeedsCmd: Include {mod}: keys without it are needed for typing.
shortcutErrReserved: This key is used for text editing or by the system and cannot be taken over.
shortcutErrConflict: Already used by “{name}” ({where}). Change that one first.
provCliNotFound: The {name} CLI was not found on this computer. Install it, then check again.
provCheckedUnknown: Time of the last check is unknown.
provStale: This status may be outdated. Check again to be sure.
updaterConfirmText: Install the update and restart the application?
updaterLinuxNote: Linux: in-app updates require AppImage. Update DEB/RPM manually.
updaterStatus_disabled: Updates are unavailable: build unconfigured or installation format unsupported.
providerCheckTimeout: The check took longer than 30 seconds
providerCheckAllHint: Check sign-in of every enabled provider
fontInvalid: Use only letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes (up to 60 characters)
wrapCode: Wrap long lines in code and diffs
wrapCodeHint: Off: scroll sideways. On: long lines continue on the next row
motionSpeedHint: Speed of transitions and animations; Off stops them
appearanceResetHint: Restores fonts, sizes, wrapping and animation speed to the defaults
appearanceSampleText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Changes show here and across the app right away.
customThemesHint: Create your own light and dark colours, share them as a JSON file, or import a theme from someone else
themeShareHint: Export saves the selected theme as a JSON file. Import reads a file and checks it before adding the theme; nothing in the file is run
themeSimpleHint: Pick the background and text colours; the other neutral colours are calculated. Use Advanced to set each colour
themeContrastLow: Text contrast is {ratio}:1; at least 4.5:1 is recommended for readability
themeImportTooLarge: The file is too large to be a theme (limit 64 KB)
themeImportNotJson: The file is not valid JSON
themeImportNotTheme: This is not a Gustaf theme file
themeImportName: The theme name is missing or contains unsupported characters
themeImportUnknownKey: The file contains an unknown field
themeImportNoPalette: The file has neither a light nor a dark palette
appDiagLead: What the app and the agents it started are doing right now, whether providers connect, and the latest errors. Secrets are hidden.
appDiagProcessesDesc: Gustaf and everything it started (agent CLIs, MCP servers, shells). Refreshed every few seconds while this page is open; other programs are never listed.
appDiagUnsupported: Process list is not available on this system.
appDiagProvidersDesc: Last known state from the provider checks. Run a check on the Model providers page.
appDiagErrorsDesc: Provider, model list, limit and MCP server errors.
appDiagLogsDesc: Open the folder with the application logs.
antigravityInstallSoon: Managed install is coming soon. Install the agent manually and set the binary path below.
antigravityNotInstalled: Not installed. Set the binary path or put agy_acp_server on PATH.
antigravityProbeError: The agent could not be started: {message}
antigravitySignInUnknown: Sign-in has not been checked yet
antigravityBinaryDesc: Path of agy_acp_server. Leave empty to look for it on PATH.
antigravityMethodDesc: Google accounts use your subscription; API keys and Agent Platform bill usage.
antigravityKeyDesc: Stored in the system Keychain, never in settings. Leave empty to keep the current key.
antigravityIssue_project: Gemini Enterprise needs a GCP project and location.
antigravityIssue_apiKeyOrProject: Agent Platform needs an API key, or a GCP project and location.
antigravityAbout: Google's Antigravity agent, run through the Agent Client Protocol. After adding it, open its settings to sign in.
